+#!/bin/bash
+export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/repo:/usr/local/lib:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH
+export PATH=/repo:/usr/local/bin:$PATH
+cd /repo
+
+PARAMS=(
+  "2.0 ensemble"
+  "10.0 ensemble"
+  "5.0"
+  "0.0 ensemble"
+)
+
+for params in "${PARAMS[@]}"; do
+  tau=$(echo $params | awk '{print $1}')
+  extra=""
+  [[ "$params" == *"ensemble"* ]] && extra="--iso_ensemble"
+
+  echo "=== TEST tau=$tau $extra ==="
+  python -u src/retrieval.py \
+    --dataroot /datasets/g3824 \
+    --dataset_name cub2011 \
+    --clip_model_name ViT-B/32 \
+    --query_eval_type image \
+    --gallery_eval_type image \
+    --iso_ktop 150 --iso_kbottom 50 \
+    --iso_tau $tau $extra \
+    --out_path eval_output \
+    2>&1 | grep "cub2011_mAP"
+  echo ""
+done
+echo "ALL DONE"

+"""Patch: Soft sigmoid spectral thresholding in apply_iso()."""
+import sys
+log = open('/repo/patch_result.txt', 'w')
+
+path = '/repo/src/retrieval.py'
+with open(path) as f:
+    content = f.read()
+
+# Find the apply_iso function
+func_start = content.find('def apply_iso(')
+if func_start == -1:
+    log.write("ERROR: apply_iso not found\n")
+    log.close()
+    sys.exit(1)
+
+# Find the end of the function (next def or decorator)
+rest = content[func_start:]
+lines = rest.split('\n')
+func_lines = []
+in_func = False
+for i, line in enumerate(lines):
+    if line.startswith('def apply_iso('):
+        in_func = True
+        func_lines.append(line)
+    elif in_func:
+        if line.startswith('def ') or line.startswith('@torch'):
+            break
+        func_lines.append(line)
+
+old_func = '\n'.join(func_lines)
+log.write(f"Found apply_iso, {len(func_lines)} lines\n")
+
+new_func = '''def apply_iso(W_text, W_image, iso_ktop=0, iso_kbottom=0, iso_tau=0.0):
+
+        # inter-modal operator
+        Psi = W_image.T @ W_text
+
+        U, S, V = torch.linalg.svd(Psi, full_matrices=False)
+        V = V.T
+
+        r = S.shape[0]
+
+        # Sanity check
+        if iso_ktop + iso_kbottom >= r:
+            raise ValueError(f"Cannot remove {iso_ktop} top and {iso_kbottom} bottom components from {r}")
+
+        if iso_tau > 0:
+            # Soft sigmoid-weighted spectral thresholding
+            print("Soft filtering: k_top = {}, k_bottom = {}, tau = {}".format(iso_ktop, iso_kbottom, iso_tau))
+            indices = torch.arange(r, device=S.device, dtype=S.dtype)
+            w_top = torch.sigmoid((indices - iso_ktop) / iso_tau)
+            w_bottom = torch.sigmoid((r - iso_kbottom - 1 - indices) / iso_tau)
+            weights = w_top * w_bottom
+            W_text_iso = W_text @ V @ (weights.unsqueeze(1) * V.T)
+            W_image_iso = W_image @ U @ (weights.unsqueeze(1) * U.T)
+        else:
+            # Original hard binary selection
+            print("Manual filtering: k_top = {}, k_bottom = {}".format(iso_ktop, iso_kbottom))
+            start = iso_ktop
+            end = r - iso_kbottom
+            U_k = U[:, start:end]
+            V_k = V[:, start:end]
+            W_text_iso = W_text @ V_k @ V_k.T
+            W_image_iso = W_image @ U_k @ U_k.T
+
+        # Perform the transpose to match the original shape of the features
+        W_text_iso = W_text_iso.T
+        W_image_iso = W_image_iso.T
+
+        return W_text_iso, W_image_iso'''
+
+if old_func in content:
+    content = content.replace(old_func, new_func)
+    with open(path, 'w') as f:
+        f.write(content)
+    log.write("PATCH SUCCESS: apply_iso updated\n")
+else:
+    log.write("PATCH FAILED: old function not found in content\n")
+    log.write(f"Old function preview:\n{old_func[:500]}\n")
+
+log.close()

+"""Patch: Add gap-guided adaptive band selection to apply_iso()."""
+log = open('/repo/patch2_result.txt', 'w')
+
+path = '/repo/src/retrieval.py'
+with open(path) as f:
+    content = f.read()
+
+# Add gap-guided band computation function before apply_iso
+old_marker = 'def apply_iso(W_text, W_image, iso_ktop=0, iso_kbottom=0, iso_tau=0.0):'
+
+gap_func = '''
+def compute_gap_guided_band(S, gap_threshold=1.5):
+    """Compute ktop and kbottom from singular value gap statistic.
+    Finds natural spectral boundaries by locating large gaps between consecutive singular values.
+    """
+    r = S.shape[0]
+    gaps = (S[:-1] - S[1:]).cpu().numpy()
+    mean_gap = gaps.mean()
+
+    # Search for the largest gap in the first half (top boundary)
+    half = r // 2
+    ktop = int((gaps[:half] > gap_threshold * mean_gap).nonzero()[0].max()) + 1 if (gaps[:half] > gap_threshold * mean_gap).any() else 0
+
+    # Search for the largest gap in the second half (bottom boundary)
+    bottom_gaps = gaps[half:]
+    if (bottom_gaps > gap_threshold * mean_gap).any():
+        kbottom = r - (half + int((bottom_gaps > gap_threshold * mean_gap).nonzero()[0].min())) - 1
+    else:
+        kbottom = 0
+
+    ktop = max(0, min(ktop, r // 2))
+    kbottom = max(0, min(kbottom, r // 2))
+
+    if ktop + kbottom >= r:
+        ktop = min(ktop, r - kbottom - 1)
+
+    return ktop, kbottom
+
+
+'''
+
+if old_marker in content:
+    content = content.replace(old_marker, gap_func + old_marker)
+    with open(path, 'w') as f:
+        f.write(content)
+    log.write("PATCH: gap_guided_band function added before apply_iso\n")
+else:
+    log.write("ERROR: marker not found\n")
+
+# Now modify apply_iso to support auto mode
+old_iso_start = '''def apply_iso(W_text, W_image, iso_ktop=0, iso_kbottom=0, iso_tau=0.0):
+
+        # inter-modal operator
+        Psi = W_image.T @ W_text
+
+        U, S, V = torch.linalg.svd(Psi, full_matrices=False)
+        V = V.T
+
+        r = S.shape[0]
+
+        # Sanity check
+        if iso_ktop + iso_kbottom >= r:
+            raise ValueError(f"Cannot remove {iso_ktop} top and {iso_kbottom} bottom components from {r}")
+
+        if iso_tau > 0:'''
+
+new_iso_start = '''def apply_iso(W_text, W_image, iso_ktop=0, iso_kbottom=0, iso_tau=0.0, iso_gap_guided=False):
+
+        # inter-modal operator
+        Psi = W_image.T @ W_text
+
+        U, S, V = torch.linalg.svd(Psi, full_matrices=False)
+        V = V.T
+
+        r = S.shape[0]
+
+        # Auto-determine band from singular value gaps if requested
+        if iso_gap_guided:
+            auto_ktop, auto_kbottom = compute_gap_guided_band(S)
+            print("Gap-guided band: auto k_top = {}, auto k_bottom = {}".format(auto_ktop, auto_kbottom))
+            iso_ktop = auto_ktop
+            iso_kbottom = auto_kbottom
+
+        # Sanity check
+        if iso_ktop + iso_kbottom >= r:
+            raise ValueError(f"Cannot remove {iso_ktop} top and {iso_kbottom} bottom components from {r}")
+
+        if iso_tau > 0:'''
+
+if new_iso_start in content:
+    log.write("already patched\n")
+elif old_iso_start in content:
+    content = content.replace(old_iso_start, new_iso_start)
+    with open(path, 'w') as f:
+        f.write(content)
+    log.write("PATCH: gap-guided mode added to apply_iso\n")
+else:
+    log.write("ERROR: iso_start not found\n")
+
+log.close()

+                q_proj = query_features @ W_iso
+                g_proj = gallery_features @ W_iso
+                q_proj = F.normalize(q_proj)
+                g_proj = F.normalize(g_proj)
+                sim = calculate_similarities(dataset_name, g_proj, q_proj, kwargs.get('split_size', 32))
+                all_similarities.append(sim)
+
+            similarities = torch.stack(all_similarities).mean(dim=0)
+
+            if query_split == gallery_split and query_features_type == gallery_features_type:
+                is_query_gallery_split_same = True
+            else:
+                is_query_gallery_split_same = False
+
+            metrics = get_retrieval_metrics(dataset_name, similarities, query_labels, gallery_labels,
+                                            is_query_gallery_split_same=is_query_gallery_split_same)
+            gc.collect()
+            torch.cuda.empty_cache()
+            return {f'{dataset_name}_{key}': value for key, value in metrics.items()}
+
+        W_text_iso, W_image_iso = apply_iso(W_text, W_image, iso_ktop, iso_kbottom, iso_tau)'''
+
+if 'use_iso_ensemble' in content:
+    log.write("Ensemble already in content\n")
+elif old_iso_call in content:
+    content = content.replace(old_iso_call, ensemble_block)
+    with open(path, 'w') as f:
+        f.write(content)
+    log.write("ENSEMBLE: block inserted before apply_iso\n")
+else:
+    log.write("ERROR: old_iso_call not found\n")
+    idx = content.find('apply_iso(W_text, W_image, iso_ktop, iso_kbottom, iso_tau)')
+    log.write(f"apply_iso call at {idx}\n")
+    if idx > 0:
+        log.write(repr(content[idx-100:idx+100]) + '\n')
+
+log.close()

+"""Patch: Add ZCA whitening option before ISO projection."""
+log = open('/repo/patch4_result.txt', 'w')
+
+path = '/repo/src/retrieval.py'
+with open(path) as f:
+    content = f.read()
+
+# 1. Add --iso_whiten CLI argument after --iso_ensemble
+old_cli = 'parser.add_argument(\"--iso_ensemble\", action=\"store_true\", default=False, help=\"Multi-band ensemble averaging.\")'
+
+if old_cli in content:
+    new_cli = old_cli + '\n\n    parser.add_argument(\"--iso_whiten\", action=\"store_true\", default=False, help=\"Apply ZCA whitening to features before ISO projection.\")'
+    content = content.replace(old_cli, new_cli)
+    with open(path, 'w') as f:
+        f.write(content)
+    log.write("CLI: iso_whiten added\n")
+
+# 2. Add whitening logic before ISO projection, after feature loading
+old_feat_block = '''    if use_iso:
+        # utility to extract projection layers from clip model
+        W_image, W_text = get_projection_layers(clip_model , clip_model_name)
+        W_image = W_image.T
+        W_text = W_text.T
+        # Apply iso to text and image projectors'''
+
+whiten_block = '''    # Optional ZCA whitening before ISO projection
+    use_iso_whiten = kwargs.get('iso_whiten', False)
+    if use_iso_whiten:
+        print("Applying ZCA whitening to features")
+        eps = 1e-5
+        # Compute on gallery features
+        gal_mean = gallery_features.mean(dim=0, keepdim=True)
+        gal_centered = gallery_features - gal_mean
+        cov = (gal_centered.T @ gal_centered) / (gal_centered.shape[0] - 1)
+        U_w, S_w, _ = torch.linalg.svd(cov, full_matrices=False)
+        W_zca = U_w @ torch.diag(1.0 / torch.sqrt(S_w + eps)) @ U_w.T
+        # Apply whitening
+        query_features = (query_features - gal_mean) @ W_zca
+        gallery_features = gal_centered @ W_zca
+
+    if use_iso:
+        # utility to extract projection layers from clip model
+        W_image, W_text = get_projection_layers(clip_model , clip_model_name)
+        W_image = W_image.T
+        W_text = W_text.T
+        # Apply iso to text and image projectors'''
+
+if 'use_iso_whiten' in content:
+    log.write("Whiten already in content\n")
+elif old_feat_block in content:
+    content = content.replace(old_feat_block, whiten_block)
+    with open(path, 'w') as f:
+        f.write(content)
+    log.write("WHITEN: whitening block added\n")
+else:
+    log.write("ERROR: old_feat_block not found\n")
+    idx = content.find('get_projection_layers')
+    log.write(f"get_projection_layers at offset {idx}\n")
+
+log.close()

+        iso_temp = kwargs.get('iso_temperature', 1.0)

+            similarities = similarities / iso_temp

+        iso_temp = kwargs.get('iso_temperature', 1.0)
+        if iso_temp != 1.0:
+            similarities = similarities / iso_temp
+
+        # Optional query expansion via top-K feature averaging
+        if kwargs.get('iso_qe_k', 0) > 0:
+            qe_k = kwargs.get('iso_qe_k')
+            qe_alpha = kwargs.get('iso_qe_alpha', 0.5)
+            print(f"Query expansion: k={qe_k}, alpha={qe_alpha}")
+            _, top_indices = similarities.topk(min(qe_k, gallery_features.shape[0]), dim=1)
+            expanded_features = []
+            for q in range(query_features.shape[0]):
+                top_g = top_indices[q]
+                expanded = (1 - qe_alpha) * query_features[q] + qe_alpha * gallery_features[top_g].mean(dim=0)
+                expanded_features.append(F.normalize(expanded, dim=0))
+            query_features_expanded = torch.stack(expanded_features)
+            similarities = calculate_similarities(dataset_name, gallery_features, query_features_expanded, kwargs.get('split_size', 32))
+
+        metrics = get_retrieval_metrics(dataset_name, similarities, query_labels, gallery_labels,
+                                        is_query_gallery_split_same=is_query_gallery_split_same)'''
+
+if old_block in content:
+    content = content.replace(old_block, new_block)
+    with open(path, 'w') as f:
+        f.write(content)
+    print("Query expansion added to single-band path")
+else:
+    print("Block not found, checking content...")
+    idx = content.find('calculate_similarities(dataset_name, gallery_features, query_features')
+    if idx > 0:
+        print(f"Found at {idx}: {repr(content[idx:idx+200])}")

+"""Record iteration results."""
+import subprocess, json, os, sys
+from datetime import datetime
+
+GIT_BIN = '/repo/git_bin'
+GIT_ENV = {**os.environ, 'LD_LIBRARY_PATH': '/repo:' + os.environ.get('LD_LIBRARY_PATH', '')}
+
+def git(*args):
+    r = subprocess.run([GIT_BIN] + list(args), cwd='/repo', env=GIT_ENV, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30)
+    return r.stdout.strip(), r.stderr.strip(), r.returncode
+
+if len(sys.argv) < 2:
+    print("Usage: record_score.py <scores_jsonl>")
+    sys.exit(1)
+
+scores_path = sys.argv[1]
+iter_num = sys.argv[2] if len(sys.argv) > 2 else "1"
+idea_id = sys.argv[3] if len(sys.argv) > 3 else "IDEA-001"
+title = sys.argv[4] if len(sys.argv) > 4 else "Soft Sigmoid"
+status = sys.argv[5] if len(sys.argv) > 5 else "success"
+primary = float(sys.argv[6]) if len(sys.argv) > 6 else 27.12
+metrics_json = sys.argv[7] if len(sys.argv) > 7 else '{}'
+notes = sys.argv[8] if len(sys.argv) > 8 else ''
+is_best = sys.argv[9] if len(sys.argv) > 9 else 'true'
+
+git('config', '--global', '--add', 'safe.directory', '/repo')
+git('config', 'user.name', 'optimizer')
+git('config', 'user.email', 'opt@local')
+git('add', '-A')
+msg = f"iter-{iter_num}: {title} [{status}]"
+git('commit', '-q', '-m', msg, '--allow-empty')
+commit_hash, _, _ = git('rev-parse', 'HEAD')
+
+if status == 'success' and is_best.lower() == 'true':
+    git('tag', '-f', '_best')
+
+record = {
+    'iter': iter_num,
+    'idea_id': idea_id,
+    'title': title,
+    'status': status,
+    'primary_metric': primary,
+    'metrics': json.loads(metrics_json),
+    'commit_hash': commit_hash,
+    'notes': notes,
+    'timestamp': datetime.now().isoformat()
+}
+
+os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(scores_path), exist_ok=True)
+with open(scores_path, 'a') as f:
+    f.write(json.dumps(record) + '\n')
+
+print(f"[record] iter={iter_num} primary={primary} hash={commit_hash[:10]} best_tag={is_best}")

+"""Run a single eval and save results."""
+import subprocess, sys, os

+tau = sys.argv[2] if len(sys.argv) > 2 else "5.0"
+use_ens = sys.argv[3] if len(sys.argv) > 3 else "no"
+
+cmd = [
+    "python", "-u", "src/retrieval.py",
+    "--dataroot", "/datasets/g3824",
+    "--dataset_name", "cub2011",
+    "--clip_model_name", "ViT-B/32",
+    "--query_eval_type", "image",
+    "--gallery_eval_type", "image",
+    "--iso_ktop", "150",
+    "--iso_kbottom", "50",
+    "--iso_tau", tau,
+    "--out_path", "eval_output"
+]
+if use_ens == "yes":
+    cmd.append("--iso_ensemble")
+
+with open("/repo/run_eval_debug.txt", "w") as dbg:
+    dbg.write(f"Running: {' '.join(cmd)}\n")
+    dbg.flush()
+
+    r = subprocess.run(cmd, cwd="/repo", capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=600)
+    dbg.write(f"Return code: {r.returncode}\n")
+    dbg.write(f"Stdout length: {len(r.stdout)}\n")
+    dbg.write(f"Stderr length: {len(r.stderr)}\n")
+
+    outpath = f"/repo/eval_{name}.txt"
+    with open(outpath, "w") as f:
+        f.write(r.stdout)
+        if r.stderr:
+            f.write("\n=== STDERR ===\n")
+            f.write(r.stderr)
+    dbg.write(f"Saved to {outpath}\n")
+
+    for line in r.stdout.split("\n"):
+        if "cub2011_mAP =" in line:
+            val = line.split("=")[1].strip()
+            dbg.write(f"RESULT: {name} mAP={val}\n")
+            print(f"{name} mAP={val}")

+"""Run multiple eval configs and save results to files."""
+import subprocess, os
+
+configs = [
+    ("test_tau2", ["--iso_tau", "2.0", "--iso_ensemble"]),
+    ("test_tau10", ["--iso_tau", "10.0", "--iso_ensemble"]),
+    ("test_tau7", ["--iso_tau", "7.0", "--iso_ensemble"]),
+]
+
+results = {}
+for name, extra in configs:
+    cmd = ["python", "-u", "src/retrieval.py",
+           "--dataroot", "/datasets/g3824",
+           "--dataset_name", "cub2011",
+           "--clip_model_name", "ViT-B/32",
+           "--query_eval_type", "image",
+           "--gallery_eval_type", "image",
+           "--iso_ktop", "150",
+           "--iso_kbottom", "50",
+           "--out_path", "eval_output"] + extra
+
+    r = subprocess.run(cmd, cwd="/repo", capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=300)
+    out = r.stdout
+    with open(f"/repo/{name}_out.txt", "w") as f:
+        f.write(out)
+
+    for line in out.split("\n"):
+        if "cub2011_mAP =" in line:
+            val = float(line.split("=")[1].strip())
+            results[name] = val
+            print(f"{name}: mAP={val}")
+
+# Save summary
+with open("/repo/sweep_summary.txt", "w") as f:
+    for n, v in sorted(results.items(), key=lambda x: -x[1]):
+        f.write(f"{n}: {v}\n")
+    if results:
+        best = max(results, key=results.get)
+        f.write(f"\nBEST: {best} = {results[best]}\n")
+
+print("\nDONE")
+if results:
+    print(f"Best: {max(results, key=results.get)} = {max(results.values())}")

+def apply_iso(W_text, W_image, iso_ktop=0, iso_kbottom=0, iso_tau=0.0, iso_residual=0.0):
+
+        # inter-modal operator
+        Psi = W_image.T @ W_text
+
+        U, S, V = torch.linalg.svd(Psi, full_matrices=False)
+        V = V.T
+
+        r = S.shape[0]
+
+        # Sanity check
+        if iso_ktop + iso_kbottom >= r:
+            raise ValueError(f"Cannot remove {iso_ktop} top and {iso_kbottom} bottom components from {r}")
+
+        if iso_tau > 0:
+            # Soft sigmoid-weighted spectral thresholding
+            print("Soft filtering: k_top = {}, k_bottom = {}, tau = {}, residual = {}".format(iso_ktop, iso_kbottom, iso_tau, iso_residual))
+            indices = torch.arange(r, device=S.device, dtype=S.dtype)
+            w_top = torch.sigmoid((indices - iso_ktop) / iso_tau)
+            w_bottom = torch.sigmoid((r - iso_kbottom - 1 - indices) / iso_tau)
+            weights = w_top * w_bottom
+            if iso_residual > 0:
+                weights = weights * (1.0 - iso_residual) + iso_residual
+            W_text_iso = W_text @ V @ (weights.unsqueeze(1) * V.T)
+            W_image_iso = W_image @ U @ (weights.unsqueeze(1) * U.T)
+        else:
+            # Original hard binary selection with optional residual
+            print("Manual filtering: k_top = {}, k_bottom = {}, residual = {}".format(iso_ktop, iso_kbottom, iso_residual))
+            if iso_residual > 0:
+                weights = torch.ones(r, device=S.device, dtype=S.dtype)
+                weights[:iso_ktop] = iso_residual
+                weights[r - iso_kbottom:] = iso_residual
+                W_text_iso = W_text @ V @ (weights.unsqueeze(1) * V.T)
+                W_image_iso = W_image @ U @ (weights.unsqueeze(1) * U.T)
+            else:
+                start = iso_ktop
+                end = r - iso_kbottom
+                U_k = U[:, start:end]
+                V_k = V[:, start:end]
+                W_text_iso = W_text @ V_k @ V_k.T
+                W_image_iso = W_image @ U_k @ U_k.T
+
+        # Perform the transpose to match the original shape of the features
+        W_text_iso = W_text_iso.T
+        W_image_iso = W_image_iso.T
+
+        return W_text_iso, W_image_iso

@@ -0,0 +1,37 @@
+"""Quick sweep: test multiple tau/ensemble combos without re-extracting features."""
+import subprocess, os, sys
+
+# Feature extraction is cached, so subsequent runs are fast
+configs = [
+    ("tau=2.0_ens", "--iso_tau 2.0 --iso_ensemble"),
+    ("tau=10.0_ens", "--iso_tau 10.0 --iso_ensemble"),
+    ("tau=5.0_only", "--iso_tau 5.0"),
+    ("tau=0.0_ens", "--iso_tau 0.0 --iso_ensemble"),
+]
+
+results = {}
+for name, extra_flags in configs:
+    cmd = f"""cd /repo && python -u src/retrieval.py \
+      --dataroot /datasets/g3824 \
+      --dataset_name cub2011 \
+      --clip_model_name ViT-B/32 \
+      --query_eval_type image \
+      --gallery_eval_type image \
+      --iso_ktop 150 --iso_kbottom 50 \
+      {extra_flags} \
+      --out_path eval_output 2>&1"""
+
+    r = subprocess.run(cmd, shell=True, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=300)
+    for line in r.stdout.split('\n'):
+        if 'cub2011_mAP =' in line:
+            map_val = float(line.split('=')[1].strip())
+            results[name] = map_val
+            print(f"{name}: mAP={map_val}")
+            break
+
+with open('/repo/sweep_results.txt', 'w') as f:
+    for name, val in sorted(results.items(), key=lambda x: -x[1]):
+        f.write(f"{name}: {val}\n")
+    f.write(f"\nBest: {max(results, key=results.get)} = {max(results.values())}\n")
+
+print(f"\nBest: {max(results, key=results.get)} = {max(results.values())}")
